backend/main.mo: Motoko canister handling Stripe config, user auth, events, and anonymous usage tracking with monthly reset logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence mapping back‑navigation features to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose and behavior of numerous frontend files.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_SLUG.md: Documentation defining the deployment slug rules and validation for the Glotaxa frontend.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme variables and base styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting metadata and loading the React app.
frontend/PRODUCTION_PUBLISH_V4.md: Version 39 production deployment checklist including build, deploy, verification, and rollback steps.
frontend/PRODUCTION_SMOKE_CHECK.md: Runbook for smoke‑testing the production app with required route checks and Stripe/auth flows.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app configuring TanStack Router, global layout, theming, and route definitions.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with error handling and query cache reset.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceD: Form step for entering invoice details, managing line items, VAT categories, validation, and risk checks.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceM: Displays mandatory invoice field validation results with icons and alerts.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceP: Renders invoice preview with compliance checks, risk analysis, quota checks, and save/download actions.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceR: Dialog showing detailed invoice risk analysis with critical issues and warnings.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main app layout with navigation tabs, branding, and analytics event logging.
frontend/src/components/payments/StripeA: Admin-only Stripe configuration form with backend integration and secure key handling.
frontend/src/components/payments/StripeC: Button that triggers Stripe checkout session creation, logs events, and redirects to the Stripe session URL.
frontend/src/components/usage/LimitReach: Modal shown when free usage is exceeded, logging an upgrade CTA and linking to the upgrade page.
frontend/src/components/usage/UpgradeMod: Upgrade modal presenting Starter and Pro plan options with event logging and navigation to the upgrade page.
frontend/src/components/usage/UsageLimit: Banner showing remaining monthly invoice usage for free-plan users based on account plan data.
frontend/src/components/vat/CountrySelec: Step UI for selecting an EU or UK country, displaying flags, VAT rates, and a back button.
frontend/src/components/vat/CountryTrans: Transaction input step handling customer details, VAT options, product categories, and logging for VAT calculation.
frontend/src/components/vat/CountryVatDe: Displays VAT details for a selected country, including rates, features, config status, and navigation controls.
frontend/src/components/vat/EuVatIntroSt: Intro step listing EU countries and allowing selection before proceeding to detailed VAT steps.
frontend/src/components/vat/ExplainVatPa: Renders VAT explanation tabs, selects explanation based on region, and shows a Pro paywall for PDF export.
Displays a dialog prompting users to upgrade to Pro when accessing restricted VAT explanations.
Shows a horizontal stepper UI highlighting progress through VAT calculation steps.
frontend/src/components/vat/GlobalDiscla: Renders a global disclaimer noting VAT variations and non‑advisory nature of the tool.
frontend/src/components/vat/ProductCateg: Provides a selectable grid of product categories with support for exempt identifiers.
frontend/src/components/vat/ReverseCharg: Validates reverse‑charge proof, logs events, and displays results with badges and explanations.
frontend/src/components/vat/TransactionD: Collects transaction details such as customer type, VAT ID, product category, and amounts before calculation.
frontend/src/components/vat/uk/UkSelectC: UI step showing UK VAT rates and a continue button.
frontend/src/components/vat/uk/UkTransac: Form for entering UK VAT transaction details with misuse warnings and navigation callbacks.
frontend/src/components/vat/VatCategoryI: Renders selectable VAT category options with labels and highlighting for the chosen item.
frontend/src/components/vat/VatResultsSt: Displays computed VAT results, classification, notes, and navigation controls based on scenario and cross‑border rules.
frontend/src/config/appMeta.ts: Defines app metadata and validates the deployment slug format.
frontend/src/hooks/useAccountPlan.ts: Fetches the user's active plan and monthly invoice usage from the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAnonymousUsage.ts: Tracks anonymous daily usage via fingerprinting and enforces a free usage limit.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCheckoutSess: Creates a Stripe checkout session through the backend and validates the returned session URL.
frontend/src/hooks/useDailyFingerprint.t: Generates a daily fingerprint and detects the user's country for analytics.
frontend/src/hooks/useEventLogger.ts: Logs analytics events using actor, fingerprint, and country metadata.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication state and provides login/logout functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useInvoiceNumberUniqu: Checks if an invoice number already exists via the backend actor.
Provides hooks for listing, downloading, and exporting invoices using backend actor methods.
frontend/src/hooks/useInvoiceQuota.ts: Handles invoice saving with plan-based quota enforcement and updates related queries.
frontend/src/hooks/usePlanAccess.ts: Derives plan info from account data and returns flags for free, starter, and pro plans.
Detects the browser’s preferred language and returns it with an English check flag.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching the current user profile and Stripe configuration state.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind styles, color variables, dark mode values, and z-index fixes for dropdowns and poppers.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/coreEvents.ts: Exports constant core analytics event names and a type representing valid event keys.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/countryDetect: Fetches IP-based country data from ipapi.co and returns country and IP when available.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/eventLogger.t: Builds and sends event records to the backend with device, page, timestamp, and metadata info.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/fingerprint.t: Generates and caches a daily SHA‑256 fingerprint based on IP, user agent, and date.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/buildInvoiceHtm: Generates an HTML invoice using details, VAT results, translations, totals, and VAT breakdowns.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/currency.ts: Provides currency lookup, formatting, and local currency helpers using VAT config and browser locale.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/deriveInvoiceVa: Computes invoice VAT outcome including rate, amount, label, currency, and error handling based on VAT results.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/getAutoLegalVat: Returns legal VAT wording based on scenario, seller country, and cross‑border treatment.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/getInvoiceWordi: Maps VAT labels and countries to standardized invoice wording with fallbacks.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/invoiceLineItem: Defines invoice line item types and utilities for calculating totals and grouping items by VAT rate.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/invoiceVatCateg: Provides VAT category notes, special scenario notes, and aggregates unique warnings for invoice line items.
Defines country‑specific text for reverse charge and VAT‑exempt scenarios with fallback wording logic.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/riskCheck.ts: Runs invoice risk checks including mandatory fields, legal text requirements, reverse‑charge validation, and scenario warnings.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/validateInvoice: Validates comprehensive invoice compliance such as seller/customer data, VAT config support, and required notes.
Checks presence of mandatory invoice fields based on scenario and returns missing fields.
frontend/src/lib/production/productionMa: Logs a production‑only version marker and exposes it for testing.
frontend/src/lib/translation/deToEn.ts: Provides deterministic German‑to‑English translation using a fixed dictionary and a heuristic German detector.
frontend/src/lib/vat/calculateUkVat.ts: Computes UK VAT based on transaction type, handling zero‑rated, reverse‑charge, exempt, and domestic VAT cases.
frontend/src/lib/vat/calculateUnifiedVat: Main VAT engine combining cross-border treatment logic with domestic VAT rate determination, then computing VAT amounts and scenario metadata.
frontend/src/lib/vat/calculateVat.ts: Defines VAT input/output types and provides EU VAT, exemption, reverse charge, and Germany-specific VAT calculation functions.
frontend/src/lib/vat/calculateVatAmounts: Simple helper computing VAT amount and gross total from net amount and rate.
frontend/src/lib/vat/categoryEligibility: Contains normalized category lists and helpers to check exempt, UK zero/reduced, and EU reduced eligibility.
frontend/src/lib/vat/deriveVatRatePercen: Derives the VAT rate to send to the backend based on country, treatment, reduced rate selection, and reverse charge rules.
frontend/src/lib/vat/determineCrossBorde: Determines cross-border VAT treatment and maps it to VAT rates, invoice wording, and display labels.
frontend/src/lib/vat/determineVatRate.ts: Implements priority-based VAT rate selection using country rules, product category eligibility, export, and reverse charge conditions.
frontend/src/lib/vat/euCountryConfig.ts: Defines VAT configurations for EU/UK countries and provides a lookup helper with UK normalization.
frontend/src/lib/vat/explainUkVat.ts: Generates detailed UK‑specific VAT explanation strings based on scenario and rate. Handles domestic, export, reverse‑charge, exempt, and fallback cases.
frontend/src/lib/vat/explainVat.ts: Produces explanatory text for German/EU VAT outcomes across multiple scenarios. Uses input and result values to describe rules like Kleinunternehmer, reverse charge, exemptions, and digital‑service VAT.
Returns simplified, kid‑friendly explanations for German/EU VAT scenarios. Covers small‑business rules, reverse charge, exemptions, digital services, reduced and standard VAT.
frontend/src/lib/vat/germanyVatRateHisto: Stores German VAT rate history and provides helpers to fetch current or historical rates. Includes logic to detect differences between invoice‑date rates and current rates.
frontend/src/lib/vat/identifierNormaliza: Normalizes identifiers to a standard form and compares them. Supports matching and list checks using lowercase and hyphenated formats.
frontend/src/lib/vat/index.ts: Barrel file exporting all VAT‑related modules and selected cross‑border VAT helpers. Centralizes VAT engine exports for external use.
frontend/src/lib/vat/isZeroVatResult.ts: Checks if a VAT result implies a 0% outcome. Returns true for explicit 0% rates or the UK export zero‑rated scenario.
frontend/src/lib/vat/ossIndicator.ts: Determines whether OSS rules apply based on service type, customer type, and EU cross‑border status. Returns a relevance flag and message.
frontend/src/lib/vat/productCategoryOpti: Defines product category options for UI and filters UK‑only categories by country. Includes exemptions via identifiers for certain categories.
frontend/src/lib/vat/promptFlowGermany.t: Contains system prompt and multi‑step flow prompts for a German VAT assistant. Guides data collection, calculation, invoice generation, and usage gating.
Defines product categories and reduced‑rate eligibility rules for EU and UK. Provides functions to check eligibility and determine reduced VAT rates.
frontend/src/lib/vat/region.ts: Defines region types, region info, normalization of country codes, region detection, and support checks.
frontend/src/lib/vat/selectedSellerCount: Parses and validates the seller country from URL parameters, normalizing UK to GB and returning validation results.
frontend/src/lib/vat/toBackendVatCalcula: Converts frontend VAT calculation input into backend payload format, normalizing countries, mapping categories, and computing VAT rate and amounts.
frontend/src/lib/vat/ukMisuseWarnings.ts: Provides UK VAT misuse warnings for certain category and service-type combinations.
frontend/src/lib/vat/ukTypes.ts: Defines UK-specific VAT transaction types, customer types, categories, and result structures.
frontend/src/lib/vat/validateReverseChar: Validates reverse charge eligibility by checking VAT ID format and matching the country prefix for B2B transactions.
frontend/src/lib/vat/vatCategoryRateRule: Contains VAT category definitions and logic for computing reduced or special VAT rates based on country and category.
frontend/src/lib/vat/vatConfig.ts: Provides base VAT rate configurations for supported countries.
frontend/src/lib/vat/vatResultBuilder.ts: Utility to build standardized VAT result objects from rate and net amount.
frontend/src/lib/vat/vatTable.ts: Central VAT table with lookup helpers, supporting code/name normalization and country metadata access.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/CalculatorFlowPage.ts: Implements the multi-step VAT calculator flow, handling form state, frontend and backend VAT calculations, and navigation.
frontend/src/pages/InvoicesPage.tsx: Lists invoices with selection and provides PDF, ZIP, CSV, and Excel download/export actions gated by plan access.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Presents the product overview, features, and region-based country selection linking to the calculator.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailurePage.ts: Shows payment failure message with options to retry or return home.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Displays successful payment confirmation and invalidates plan cache before offering navigation options.
frontend/src/pages/UpgradePage.tsx: Shows plan options and triggers Stripe checkout for authenticated users with event logging.
frontend/src/utils/downloadFile.ts: Creates a Blob from text or binary data and triggers a browser download for the given filename.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and clearing them from the URL or session.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color system, extended theme settings, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Sets up Vite with React, environment variable plugins, path aliasing, build output options, a dev server proxy, and esbuild global definition fixes.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, current features, pending feature requests, and configuration for project state versioning and clarification mode.
